Dear [Mr Smith](/person/1344)
Here is the [receipt](/topic/160) with many thanks. I ought to have returned Madge Wylie sooner. If of the right length, it would be a grand thing to have a Greek story for the [Christmas number](/periodical/52) it would be so much out of the ordinary beat.[^1] I have three or four come in already, not at all bad ones - but I hope they may still be excelled

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge


[^1]: \'Madge Wylie\' is not identified and the Greek story does not seem to have appeared in the Christmas 1888 number of MP.
